verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֑יִם הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃
verses.en: Hallelujah. Praise ye the LORD from the  heavens; Praise Him in the heights.
Praise ye Him, all His angels; Praise ye Him, all His hosts.

verses.he: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֑חַ הַ֝לְל֗וּהוּ כָּל־כּ֥וֹכְבֵי אֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Praise ye Him, sun and moon; Praise Him, all ye stars of light.

verses.he: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝הַמַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ מֵעַ֬ל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.en: Praise Him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens.

verses.he: יְֽ֭הַֽלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י ה֭וּא צִוָּ֣ה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ׃
verses.en: Let them praise the name of the LORD; For He commanded, and they were created.

verses.he: וַיַּעֲמִידֵ֣ם לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם חָק־נָ֝תַ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר׃
verses.en: He hath also established them for ever and ever; He hath made a decree which shall not be transgressed.
Praise the LORD from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps;

verses.he: אֵ֣שׁ וּ֭בָרָד שֶׁ֣לֶג וְקִיט֑וֹר ר֥וּחַ סְ֝עָרָ֗ה עֹשָׂ֥ה דְבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Fire and hail, snow and vapour, Stormy wind, fulfilling His word;
Mountains and all hills, Fruitful trees and all cedars;
Beasts and all cattle, Creeping things and winged fowl;
Kings of the earth and all peoples, Princes and all judges of the earth;
Both young men and maidens, Old men and children;

verses.he: יְהַלְל֤וּ׀ אֶת־שֵׁ֬ם יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־נִשְׂגָּ֣ב שְׁמ֣וֹ לְבַדּ֑וֹ ה֝וֹד֗וֹ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.en: Let them praise the name of the LORD, For His name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and heaven.

verses.he: וַיָּ֤רֶם קֶ֨רֶן׀ לְעַמּ֡וֹ תְּהִלָּ֤ה לְֽכָל־חֲסִידָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֣י יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל עַֽם־קְרֹב֗וֹ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: And He hath lifted up a horn for His people, A praise for all His saints, Even for the children of Israel, a people near unto Him. Hallelujah.
